preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
Each test case must have dimensions n and m between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each row in the binary table must have a length equal to m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for row in table for c in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the binary table must be either '0' or '1'.
The total number of cells across all test cases must not exceed 20000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{x1} {y1} {x2} {y2} {x3} {y3}' for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of operations k followed by k lines of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in [(x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3) for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations])
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the operations must be within the bounds of the table.

postconditions.expression: len(set((x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3))) == 3 for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations
postconditions.description: Each operation must involve three distinct cells.

postconditions.expression: all(table[x1-1][y1-1] == '0' and table[x2-1][y2-1] == '0' and table[x3-1][y3-1] == '0' for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: After all operations, all cells in the table must be equal to '0'.
